primary.title: Hindalco Q4 Results: Net profit drops 51% YoY to ₹2,597 crore; declares final dividend of ₹5 per share
primary.summary: Hindalco Industries reported a 51% decline in Q4FY26 net profit, totaling ₹2,597 crore, due to increased expenses from a fire at its US subsidiary, Novelis. However, consolidated revenue rose 20.4% to ₹78,133 crore, boosted by higher base metal prices.
